title: Rav Dimi bar Chinena (I)

paragraphs: Hyman calls him Rav Chisda's colleague. In Zevachim 36b, Rav Chisda says that Rav Dimi bar Chinena regularly taught that one is liable on grounds of impurity for unroasted meat of the Passover offering. In Rosh Hashanah 34b, R' Chiyya, son of Rabbah bar Nachmani (whom Hyman calls a student of Rav Chisda), went and presented the teaching before Rav Dimi bar Chinena. The supplied notice breaks off: “And there is [1]…”

notes.text: The supplied Hebrew itself ends after ויש [1]. Its missing continuation is not reconstructed from the English draft.

No primary scalar was returned or newly inspected. Hyman's colleague characterization and the unroasted-Passover-meat impurity quotation remain attributed source assertions, not new legal or historical adjudications. Rosh Hashanah 34b has Chiyya going to state the teaching before Rav Dimi, and the Rav Chisda-student parenthesis remains attached as supplied. The actual Hebrew ends at ויש [1]; neither continuation nor footnote content is reconstructed. The uninspected Chiyya title is R', while all supplied full Rav titles remain full.

The Zevachim passage also mentions thanksgiving-offering loaves in the same ruling, beyond Hyman's excerpt. Rosh Hashanah records Chiyya presenting the teaching before Rav Dimi. Hyman supplies Chiyya's identification as a student of Rav Chisda. In the print (vol. I, pp. 331–332), the notice likewise stops at ויש; the next heading introduces Rav Dimi bar Chinena (II).
